question.text:
System1 Group's Test Your Ad shows each new UK TV ad to a nationally representative sample of UK adults, measures their second-by-second emotional response and publishes a Star Rating from 1.0 to 5.9 stars (one decimal) that predicts the ad's long-term brand-building potential. What Star Rating will System1 publish for the following UK Christmas 2026 ad? Ad description:
Brand: Sainsbury's (UK)
Ad title: Sainsbury’s big delivery.
Released: 1 November 2026 (official YouTube release)
Length of the main edit: 120 seconds
Format: not stated (visual effects by Electric Theatre Collective)
Setting: A festive food delivery journey to Giant Country.
Characters: Annie, a Sainsbury's colleague; Fred, her sidekick; the BFG (licensed Roald Dahl character, recurring in the brand's Christmas ads); the Greedy Giant (licensed character); an oversized Squizzly Scotch-Hopper.
Story:
1. The BFG falls ill before Christmas.
2. Annie and Fred set off at speed in a van full of festive food, bound for Giant Country.
3. On the way they have a run-in with the Greedy Giant.
4. They also encounter an oversized Squizzly Scotch-Hopper.
5. They reach the BFG's cave with Sainsbury's Taste the Difference products.
6. Annie tells the BFG that "nobody should miss Christmas", and the three share a festive meal.
Music: not stated.
Dialogue and voiceover: Annie says "nobody should miss Christmas"; other lines not stated.
Tone: magical, comedic
Brand and product presence: Taste the Difference products (including a Slow Cooked Turkey Crown and a Brussels Sprout and Cavolo Nero Gratin) are delivered and eaten in the final meal. End line not stated. The official upload caption reads "BFG missing Christmas? Not on Sainsbury’s watch!"
